page_summary: This page discusses unique challenges and barriers to improving cybersecurity in ports, focusing on risk management, incident response, and collaboration. It poses prompts regarding available skills, risk assessment practices, and effective response strategies. The section emphasizes the importance of understanding cyber risks and the interface between IT and OT, as well as the need for collaboration and information sharing among ports and industry stakeholders.
